createfirefightingadd.ponder.fire_hose_c: Fire Hoses carry fluid when driven by an external pump, even across moving physical structures.

The hose inherits the pump дальность: дистанция from pump to hose plus дистанция behind the output hose equals the pump's total дальность. Non-Create pumps are supported, but may have compatibility issues.
Try using different dyes to цвет the hose, or use a Phantom Membrane to скрыть its flexible section.
Пожарный рукав Соединитель modes and reconnection
Пожарный рукав Connectors have three modes: Idle, Fixed, and Free.
In Idle mode, a redstone pulse highlights the cached partner endpoint. With no cached endpoint, it reports that the cached endpoint is missing and does not connect.
Fixed mode remembers the last connected hose endpoint and tries to restore that saved connection while it is still in дальность.
When a hose is already connected, signal the Пожарный рукав Соединитель again to disconnect it.
If there is no saved endpoint, or the saved endpoint is missing or too far away, Fixed mode will not choose a different endpoint.
Free mode scans nearby space and connects to the nearest available hose endpoint it can find.

createfirefightingadd.ponder.high_pressu: High Pressure Насос дальность and pressure
